chart_review_items.title: Add tuple-aware selection for nonrectangular multicell choices
chart_review_items.current_state: Current filter types are field-based values/ranges/text/date-ranges.
chart_review_items.desired_outcome: Selecting two region/channel pairs selects exactly those pairs.
acceptance_criteria: (North, Web) OR (South, Retail) excludes the two unselected cross combinations.
Interactions within one selection and intersections across views are specified.
Selection survives serialization and data replacement according to a documented rule.
Facet membership is included when the intended selection is local to a facet.
Visual filtering and record inspection use the identical predicate.

gap_register_items.desired_outcome: Compose filters predictably, including the same field twice
gap_register_items.current_evidence_based_assessment: The workspace model intersects independent chart predicates; selected categorical pairs are two intersected field filters.
gap_register_items.remaining_boundary_or_proof_gap: Arbitrary unions of category pairs need pair predicates, not independent lists. Effective intersection counts and contradiction explanations remain verification/product gaps.
gap_register_items.evidence_scope: Direct-source where linked; otherwise repository-reported implementation, not independently runtime-confirmed

gap_register_items.current_evidence_based_assessment: The reviewed model applies chart selection across facets and labels its scope.
gap_register_items.remaining_boundary_or_proof_gap: Facet-key-bounded XY selection is a separate missing option, not a bug in the approved global-coordinate default.

current_assessment.statement: FilterTypes.ts defines field-level predicates. Heatmap and Sankey use intersected fields for one selected pair. BaseChart settings now support localFilters, but those restrictions do not supply arbitrary tuple unions or facet-bound XY membership.
current_assessment.evidence_scope: Source inspection only; no fresh application browser proof.
